Our Approach

Reducing Dependency on Low Frequency Models

TraceSeis has developed a methodology for advanced reservoir property estimation that reduces reliance on traditional Low Frequency Models, providing a more streamlined workflow for reservoir characterization.

By leveraging relative rock properties, the approach computes reservoir properties directly from seismic data, reducing required user inputs and simplifying complex workflows.
